## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `dotnet test` passes.
- [ ] New UI text has its German translation in `SharedResource.de.resx`, and follows the "Languages" rules in docs/roadmap.md.
- [ ] Docs (README, docs/, CHANGELOG.md) are updated where people would look for this.
- [ ] No real archive material, personal data or secrets in code, tests, screenshots or commit messages.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md.
